statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is the maximum, over all subsets S of the column set {0,...,n-1} with |S| = numSelect, of C(S), where C(S) is the number of rows i with 0 <= i < m such that for every j with 0 <= j < n and matrix[i][j] = 1, the column j belongs to S. Equivalently, r = max_{S subset of {0,...,n-1}, |S| = numSelect} C(S).
preconditions: Let m = len(matrix) and n = len(matrix[0]). The input satisfies: 1 <= m <= 12; 1 <= n <= 12; for every i with 0 <= i < m, len(matrix[i]) = n; for every i,j with 0 <= i < m and 0 <= j < n, matrix[i][j] is either 0 or 1; and 1 <= numSelect <= n.
